title: KIRUPA | Build with AI. Understand the Why and How.
subtitle: Go beyond AI-generated results. Learn the code, design, and product thinking behind what you build through practical tutorials, videos, and conversations.

posts.title: Creating a Morph Animation Without Actually Morphing
posts.description: Fake a shape morph with plain CSS by animating border-radius, clip-path points, crossfades, and a squash-and-swap trick. Includes a live demo.

posts.title: Random Colors and a Bouncy Square
posts.description: Build a square that bounces around the screen and changes color every time it hits a wall, using requestAnimationFrame, velocity, and random HSL colors.

posts.title: The Importance of Frame Rates
posts.description: What frame rate is, why 60fps and 120Hz screens matter, what causes jank when frames drop, and how to measure the frame rate of your animations.
